question: How do engineers and scientists manage James Webb Space Telescope during deep space missions?
short_answer: Managing James Webb Space Telescope requires advanced orbital mechanics, specialized thermal control systems, and rigorous safety protocols developed by space agencies worldwide.
full_explanation: Detailed technical breakdown: In long-duration spaceflight, James Webb Space Telescope poses fundamental engineering and physiological challenges. Mission teams utilize automated telemetry monitoring, redundant life support loops, and high-strength composite materials to maintain operational safety in harsh microgravity environments.
